sentences.text:
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Ashok Kumar who appears for the informant as well as learned AGA and perused the record.
2. The accused-applicant seeks bail in Case Crime No.225 of 2024 under sections 376-DA, 506 IPC and section 5/6 POCSO Act, P.S. Ashiyana, District Lucknow.
3. The FIR in question was lodged as a missing person report alleging that the daughter of the informant aged about 13 years was missing and some unknown person had enticed her.
In the statement under section 164 Cr.P.C., the victim did not support the prosecution story.
The radio-logical age of the victim is around 15 years.
The medical on record does not indicate the use of any force.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Considering the two statements not supporting the prosecution and there being any adjudication with regard to the exact age of the victim, which shall be done at the time of trial, the applicant who is in custody since 11.07.2024 is entitled for the bail.
Thus the bail application is allowed.

5. Let the applicant Ayan be released on bail in aforesaid first information report number subject to his furnishing a personal bond and two reliable sureties of Rs.20,000/- (Twenty Thousand) each of the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 12.9.2024 VNP/-
